_base.description: Base config that all subsequent analyzers, even unspecified will inherit.

cyclop.description: Complexity is not checked in test files

gosec.description: Exclude G703, G705, G706 (CLI false positives), G602 (SSA slice bounds false positives), and preset-suppressed rules

shadow.description: Shadow analyzer - disabled until shadow issues in codebase are fixed

only_files.^$: Match nothing - effectively disables this analyzer
